title: Firewall groups backend validation hardening and HTTP status fix
acceptance_criteria: Firewall groups batch API validates group names server-side.
Firewall groups batch API validates value payloads by operation type server-side.
Firewall groups batch API preserves HTTPException status codes instead of converting them to 500.
Backend tests cover invalid group name, invalid remote URL, invalid MAC, and valid remote-group success paths.
Backend and frontend validation commands pass for this slice.
assumptions: Validation is intentionally strict for malformed values and should block invalid writes before commit.
Playwright browser smoke remains out-of-gate due host dependency and is intentionally excluded this cycle.

tasks.notes: Added typed validation helpers for group names and operation values; fixed HTTPException passthrough in batch endpoint.
Added API tests for invalid-name/URL/MAC 400 responses and valid remote-group success path.
Manual review pass pending before moving to next firewall-depth slice.

commands.test: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_firewall_groups_validation.py tests/test_containers_automation_v1.py tests/test_firewall_nat_save_apply_reload_loops.py tests/test_firewall_nat_config_snapshots.py && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false && npm run -s smoke:runtime
